text:
{collection}.{field}: no longer deprecated.
Clients that stopped writing it would not write it again.
Keep it deprecated, and add a new field instead.
when: Under the lock's name, when `ncdb model build` or `ncdb model check` refuses the change against the previous lock, and in the error of opening with a lock the database refuses against the one it was last opened with: a deprecated field is no longer deprecated.
